newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick halts Peru project, takes charge.
newsitem.headline: Barrick halts Peru project, takes charge.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp said on Tuesday it will not proceed with the Cerro Corona project in Peru and as a result will take a C$38 million after-tax charge to third quarter earnings.
Barrick said while its gold and copper mineralization is substantial, further exploration has found the extent of the find was not sufficient to meet Barrick's criteria for development.
Barrick said it has decided to channel its development capital into its recently acquired Arequipa assets and other "promising" exploration properties.
"They have the potential to make much more significant additions to reserves and production," Barrick executive vice president Alan Hill said in a statement.
